description: This Java source file defines the PaymentsController class, part of a Spring MVC web application. It handles admin-related HTTP requests for managing payment methods, including listing available payment modules, displaying and saving payment configurations, and deleting payment methods. The controller interacts with services to retrieve and modify payment-related data and sets up data for rendering views.

classes.name: PaymentsController
classes.description: Controller managing admin payment method operations, including listing, viewing, saving, and deleting payment methods.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list available and configured payment modules for a store.

methods.name: displayPaymentMethod
methods.description: Displays the form for editing or creating a specific payment method's configuration.

methods.name: savePaymentMethod
methods.description: Processes POST requests to save the configuration of a payment method, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: deletePaymentMethod
methods.description: Handles POST request to delete a payment method configuration.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up the admin menu context for views.
